Phone and watch independently verify access for the same Apple Account. A trial cold start makes an HTTPS time-check request to www.apple.com without chats, API keys, or recordings. Chats are saved on the watch and synced to the phone after reconnecting. Uncertain timeouts or partial replies are not automatically retried on another route.

i18n.web_search_timed_out_try: Web search timed out. Try again or turn off web search.
i18n.when_enabled_web_search_runs: When enabled, web search runs before the current text model answers. Search settings sync automatically to paired watches.
i18n.when_over_budget_send_recent: When over budget, send recent complete turns without deleting local history. The current message, prompts and search evidence are never silently truncated. This setting applies to phone and desktop chats.
i18n.when_reusing_a_key: When reusing a key, the API base URL must match the text provider
i18n.when_web_search_is_enabled: When web search is enabled, your question and search key go directly to the selected search provider. Web material is then sent to the text model. Reply sources are stored in the unencrypted local database.
i18n.you_can_enter_a_model: You can enter a model ID if fetching fails. The key is never stored in the chat database.
i18n.you_can_use_a_model: You can use a model that is missing from the server list.
i18n.your_messages_show_the_model: Your messages show the model and character count. Timing and tokens cover the whole reply request. Missing statistics in old messages stay hidden; providers without usage data show Token —.
i18n.openai_storefront_unavailable: OpenAI services are unavailable for the China mainland App Store or while the storefront is unknown. Choose another service.
i18n.supports_compatible_chat_protocols: Supports compatible Chat Completions and Claude Messages protocols.
i18n.system_voice_setup_hint: System recognition and speech need no voice API key. Hold to record on iPhone; use system dictation or keyboard on Apple Watch. Recognition may use Apple servers for some languages or devices. You can also choose a custom voice service.
i18n.system_speech_permission: Allow speech recognition for AI Link in iPhone Settings
i18n.system_speech_unavailable: System voice is unavailable for this language or device. Check system settings or choose a custom voice service.
i18n.system_voice_failed: System voice failed. Try again or choose a custom voice service.
i18n.system_voice_privacy: Apple system recognition needs no voice API key. iPhone uses on-device recognition when supported; otherwise Apple may process the recording. Apple Watch dictation is handled by the system, then the returned text is sent to your selected text model. System speech uses voices available on the device. Custom voice services receive recordings or text directly.
i18n.apple_watch_system_voice_hint: Apple Watch defaults to system dictation and speech; only a text model is required. Change recognition and speech separately in Voice services. Custom recognition uses hold-to-record.
i18n.system_speech_voice_hint: Lists voices available on this device for the current language. Apple Watch can follow iPhone or select its own voice. An unavailable voice falls back to the default.
i18n.watch_system_dictation_recommendati: For a more seamless watch voice experience, consider configuring your own speech recognition service. Apple Watch system dictation uses Apple’s input screen. A custom recognition service enables hold-to-record, slide-to-cancel and transcription review gestures.
i18n.attachment_image_failed: Could not process this image. Try saving it again before adding it.
i18n.attachment_drop_here: Drop to add images or files
i18n.attachment_drop_files_only: Drop images or files. Folders are not supported.
